name: makefun-quiet-tandem-joke
description: One-line joke about working beside AI coding agents, written by a program to /output/entry.txt.

scripts.check: node main.ts && node --input-type=module -e "import{readFileSync}from'node:fs';const t=readFileSync('out/entry.txt','utf8');const n=[...t].length;if(!t.trim()||n<1||n>280)throw new Error('gate: '+n+' code points');console.log('gate ok:',n,'code points,'+Buffer.byteLength(t),'bytes')"
